description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractUserRole' that serves as a base for user role management within the OrangeHRM system. It includes traits for authentication and user services, manages permissions, and provides methods for retrieving accessible entities and their properties, though several methods are marked as deprecated or not yet implemented.

classes.name: AbstractUserRole
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for user roles with permission handling, entity access control, and base functionalities for OrangeHRM's authorization system.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Deprecated method designed to retrieve accessible entities of a specified type, based on given operations and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Deprecated method for fetching properties of accessible entities, based on permissions and sorting.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of entities of a specified type that the user has access to, considering permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to retrieve IDs of accessible entities for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns a list of employees associated with a specific role; default implementation returns an empty array.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjects
methods.description: Deprecated method placeholder for getting accessible project entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancies
methods.description: Deprecated method placeholder for getting accessible vacancy entities.

methods.name: areRequiredPermissionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the required permissions across data groups and actions.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch items available to the user based on permissions.
